## Context

F25 and F27 are approved. Exit-code guidance omits the completion path marked verdict_obtainable=false. Five public mutation wrappers lack client-facing documentation following the library write-surface split.

## Plan

- Document retryable raised LLMError failures and results marked verdict_obtainable=false as exit 11.
- Distinguish those paths from ordinary completion failure and nonretryable indeterminate outcomes.
- Document unlink, tag, untag, archive, and compact signatures, effects, errors, repository selection, event or storage effects, and publication behavior.
- Remove stale shell-history narration where it obscures current compact behavior.
- Compare each documentation statement with its named code path or public signature.
- Change no public behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] docs/exit-codes.md documents exit 11 for a retryable LLMError raised during completion verification.
- [x] docs/exit-codes.md documents exit 11 when bounded completion recovery returns verdict_obtainable=false.
- [x] Ordinary completion failure and nonretryable indeterminate outcomes remain distinct.
- [x] Public docstrings in src/rebar/_lib_mutations.py cover each named mutation wrapper.
- [x] docs/reuse-surface.md covers each named mutation wrapper.
- [x] Reviewer inspection confirms that the documentation matches the named code paths and signatures.
- [x] The commands in Verification pass.
- [x] No public behavior changes.

## Verification

- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_leaf_writes_parity.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`
- Review docs/exit-codes.md against `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py::_verify_completion` and `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py::_completion_precheck`.
- Review docs/reuse-surface.md and each public docstring against the corresponding signature in src/rebar/_lib_mutations.py.
